paragraphs: PostPlus helps your agent turn public research, product facts, and media references into useful marketing decisions and creative assets.
Describe the result you want. The matching skill guides the task directly, while the CLI handles execution, account access, cost confirmation, and clear recovery actions.
Human judgment stays central: you set the direction, approve important decisions, and review the result. Current capabilities are listed by the CLI from its bundled catalog.

releaseNotes.title: Reliable installation and clear recovery.
releaseNotes.summary: Install the skills paired with your CLI, reuse correct installations, and get a clear next step when work cannot continue.
highlights: Skills ship with the CLI. Once the package is available, skill installation and content checks do not need GitHub.
Installation verifies supported agent targets, skips correct content, and repairs missing targets without repeating completed work.
Local changes and content without a trusted prior fingerprint are protected until backup and replacement are approved.
Public command help is available without login or business requests, with examples and useful next steps.
Failures retain structured diagnostics; exhausted automatic recovery stops instead of starting another update or task retry.
Shared guidance is shorter and selected by task. Disk installation and a refreshed agent session are reported separately.

skills.name: audio-generation
skills.description: Plan TTS, voice cloning, voice change, translated dub, or lip-sync audio. Resolve voice and reference policy before handing a ready request to voice-batch-runner.
skills.example: Plan a translated dub that preserves the speaker’s approved voice.

skills.name: audio-transcription
skills.description: Transcribe local or remote audio into text and timestamps. Convert an existing timed transcript locally into SRT or ASS without another transcription job.
skills.example: Transcribe this interview audio and give me an SRT subtitle file.

skills.name: authority-ad
skills.description: Design or review expert-led, insider, case-story, or interview ads that explain a problem mechanism using approved evidence and a credible product solution.
skills.example: Write an expert-led ad explaining the problem this product solves.

skills.name: before-after-ad
skills.description: Design or review before-and-after ads with matched comparisons, approved transformation evidence, and a clear product role. Produce a grounded shot script.
skills.example: Create a before-and-after ad using these approved product results.

skills.name: benchmark-to-brief
skills.description: Turn existing benchmark reports, pattern tables, or audience evidence into grounded campaign briefs, concepts, hooks, and test plans.
skills.example: Turn this competitor research into a campaign brief and three testable concepts.

skills.name: cartoon-ad
skills.description: Design or review animated ads that explain a product through visual arguments, metaphors, and grounded proof. Produce a script ready for creative production.
skills.example: Make an animated ad concept that explains this product visually.

skills.name: commercial-ad
skills.description: Design or review product commercials with a controlled visual mechanism, observable product behavior, sound, and payoff. Produce a brief or shot script.
skills.example: Write a short product commercial with a striking reveal and clear proof.

skills.name: educational-ad
skills.description: Design or review educational and explainer ads that answer a viewer question with clear reasoning, visual evidence, and an earned product introduction.
skills.example: Explain this customer problem in an educational ad for our product.

skills.name: facebook-research
skills.description: Research public Facebook pages, groups, posts, reels, comments, ads, events, marketplace listings, and profiles for audience or competitor evidence.
skills.example: Compare the public posts and comments on these competitor Facebook pages.

skills.name: google-trends-research
skills.description: Research Google Trends keyword momentum, regional interest, and related queries. Use search-interest evidence without treating it as sales or total demand.
skills.example: Compare search interest in these product ideas across two markets.

skills.name: image-batch-runner
skills.description: Execute ready image briefs and edits, including product or persona images and batch variants. Use resolved references and return image assets with saved run results.
skills.example: Generate these approved image variants using the supplied references.

skills.name: image-generation
skills.description: Plan image creation or edits from prompts, products, or references. Resolve task type, model, and reference rules before handing ready requests to image-batch-runner.
skills.example: Plan three product images using these photos and our launch brief.

skills.name: instagram-research
skills.description: Research public Instagram accounts, posts, Reels, comments, hashtags, and creators for audits, benchmarks, audience voice, or collaboration shortlists.
skills.example: Find Instagram creators whose recent posts fit this product.

skills.name: lifestyle-ad
skills.description: Design lifestyle ads where product capability supports a desirable human state. Produce or review shot scripts with grounded product behavior and subtle proof.
skills.example: Turn these product features into a calm, aspirational lifestyle ad.

skills.name: media-analysis
skills.description: Analyze videos, images, or carousels with visible and audible evidence. Answer visual questions, inspect frames, or compare references shot by shot when requested.
skills.example: Explain what happens in this video and show the frames supporting your analysis.

skills.name: pinterest-search
skills.description: Find public Pinterest images from a keyword for moodboards and visual inspiration. Return usable image links, source pins, and titles.
skills.example: Find minimalist kitchen images for a moodboard, with source links.

skills.name: postplus-workspace
skills.description: Maintain a project folder with approved product facts, campaign context, and reusable results. Use for ongoing work, not required for one-off tasks.
skills.example: Keep the approved product facts and results in this project folder.

skills.name: reddit-search
skills.description: Research public Reddit posts, comments, communities, and explicitly requested profiles for pain points, product opinions, and discussion evidence.
skills.example: Find the problems people discuss about portable coffee makers on Reddit.

skills.name: reference-decode
skills.description: Turn reference videos, frames, or contact sheets into reusable hook and visual rules for new creative prompts, with clear imitation boundaries.
skills.example: Extract reusable visual and hook rules from these reference frames.

skills.name: social-media-publisher
skills.description: Prepare and manage social publishing requests through PostPlus, with explicit approval before publishing or other account changes.
skills.example: Prepare these posts for our connected channels and show me what needs approval.

skills.name: street-interview-ad
skills.description: Design or review street-interview and vox-pop ads using candid conversation, a clear question, product interaction, and grounded proof.
skills.example: Write a street-interview ad that tests this product claim with a demonstration.

skills.name: tiktok-research
skills.description: Research public TikTok videos, comments, creators, profiles, related videos, and paid ad examples for audience evidence and creative benchmarks.
skills.example: Find TikTok product demos and the questions viewers ask in their comments.

skills.name: ugc-ad
skills.description: Design or review creator-led product ads, testimonials, demos, tutorials, unboxings, or POV concepts with believable interaction and approved proof.
skills.example: Write a natural creator-led product demo based on this brief.

skills.name: video-batch-runner
skills.description: Generate videos from briefs, prompts, images, audio, or reference clips. Choose a supported model, submit one or many clips, resume runs, and download results.
skills.example: Generate a short video from this approved script and reference image.

skills.name: video-transcription
skills.description: Transcribe speech in local or remote videos with timestamps. Convert existing timed transcripts locally into SRT or ASS; use media-analysis for visual understanding.
skills.example: Create a timed transcript and subtitles for this video.

skills.name: voice-batch-runner
skills.description: Execute approved voice design or cloning requests from scripts and persona references. Return reusable audio takes and saved run results with consistent voice identity.
skills.example: Generate these approved voice takes from the scripts and voice reference.

skills.name: x-research
skills.description: Research public X posts, threads, replies, and accounts for audience language, creator discovery, competitor benchmarks, and campaign evidence.
skills.example: Find X discussions and replies about this product category.

skills.name: youtube-research
skills.description: Research public YouTube channels, video metrics, and comment samples; obtain downloadable video records when requested. Use for content and audience evidence.
skills.example: Summarize this YouTube channel and the questions in its video comments.
